title: FE↔BIZ-001: Market KPIs to Surface + Dashboard UX Requirements (DERIVED — provisional)
description: Business Consultant identifies market/business KPIs to surface to operators, executives, customers, and investors; Frontend returns dashboard UX feasibility, supported aggregation granularities, and the dashboard query-performance SLO. SOURCE GAP: there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Frontend or Business Consultant side (FE §6 lists no BIZ; BIZ §6 lists no FE). This schema is DERIVED from BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.1 (business-value/market-KPI deliverables), FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3 (UX prototypes + feasibility + acceptance criteria), and DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.12 (dashboard-facing query SLO: p95 ≤ 2 s, p99 ≤ 5 s; granularities 1m/5m/15m/1h). It is PROVISIONAL pending ratification of a formal §6 FE↔BIZ contract (recommend a CCR). No KPI numeric thresholds are invented here.

market_kpis.description: BIZ→FE: market/business KPIs to surface. KPI numeric targets are intentionally optional strings — not invented.

kpi_target.description: Optional target/threshold as supplied by BIZ (not fabricated; null when unspecified).

dashboard_ux.description: FE→BIZ: dashboard UX feasibility + performance envelope.

supported_granularities.description: Aggregation granularities available for dashboard views (per DATA §6.12).

query_performance_slo.description: Dashboard-facing query SLO inherited from DATA §6.12.

p95_seconds.description: p95 dashboard queries return within 2 seconds.

p99_seconds.description: p99 dashboard queries return within 5 seconds.

view_criticality.description: Whether operator workflow depends on the view.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine dashboard requirement intake / UX feasibility is agent-autonomous. Elevated by the source gap: see source_status.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — no direct §6 contract exists on either side. Composed from BIZ §6.1 + FE §6.3 + DATA §6.12. RECOMMENDED ACTION: ratify a formal FE↔BIZ §6 interface contract via a CCR before this schema is treated as authoritative. Until then, agents must COUNTER (request §6 ratification) rather than CONFIRM a binding change.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (dashboard data requirements ≥2 weeks before development of a new view; monthly query-performance review) — inherited from FE §6.3 / DATA §6.12 pending a ratified FE↔BIZ cadence
confirm_conditions: each market_kpi carries kpi_id, kpi_name, business_rationale, and target_audience
query_performance_slo holds the inherited p95 ≤ 2 s / p99 ≤ 5 s envelope
reject_conditions: a KPI numeric threshold asserted that BIZ did not supply (no invented metrics — measure-first)
query SLO weakened below the DATA §6.12 p95/p99 envelope without a DATA-side change
this provisional schema cited as a ratified contract without the recommended CCR
counter_conditions: ALWAYS until ratified: request a formal §6 FE↔BIZ contract + CCR before treating CONFIRM as binding
KPI lacks a measurable definition — request the metric definition and data source from BIZ/DATA
Critical view cannot meet the inherited query SLO — request a DATA pre-aggregation/materialized view
